originality.rationale: Inspected Marques de Sá (2016), Theorems 6.1–6.2, prove rank feasibility and simultaneous-similarity orbit counts, but no finite-field pointwise orbit sizes. The new result gives each orbit cardinality via semilinear congruence-layer stabilizers and a complete joint factor-rank polynomial for homogeneous unipotent fixed targets; 2023 existence and 2012 regular-semisimple work do not imply these quantitative formulas as written. A conceptually related orbit-stabilizer derivation could exist in unindexed older literature, so absolute priority is not certified.
residual_risks: An equivalent numerical factorization enumerator may be buried in older unindexed literature or obtained by a prior explicit centralizer-size theorem.
The 2016 canonical classification is a close predecessor; the independently required finite-field orbit-size computation is a quantitative refinement, not a new classification.

value.rationale: Exact prescribed-product two-involution fiber cardinalities are natural finite-group structure constants, rather than just existence/rank feasibility. For every odd q and arbitrary homogeneous block multiplicity and size, the q-dependent weights reveal a parity-switched orbit-size law invisible to the previously known orbit-count support; even-length residual strata yield distinct weights despite identical factor eigenranks.
